title: Following the second van to Noise Cancellation Technologies (NCT)

tellings.quote: and it went to um a a company called Noise Cancellation Technology, NCT.

plain: In 1991, near an NSA training site in Linthicum, Maryland, Dan Sherman says he followed a second van and watched it go to a company called Noise Cancellation Technologies, or NCT. Sherman, a former sergeant who says the NSA hired him to communicate with aliens, tells Michels he saw this himself, and offers it as a hint about who was keeping watch on him.
